#430 · Big Boss Pokémon

Honchkrow

Dark Flying

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Honchkrow is a Dark/Flying-type Big Boss Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.9 m tall and weighs 27.3 kg. It evolves from Murkrow. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 505.
